event_id.description: the event's id, as a read of the calendar gave it

event_title.description: the event's title as that read gave it; nothing changes if the event's title differs

version.description: the event's etag as that read gave it; the change is made only while the event is still that version

start.description: a new start, a local date and time in time_zone; named with end and time_zone

end.description: a new end, the same way; named with start and time_zone

time_zone.description: the IANA time zone of the new times; named with start and end

location.description: a new location; empty clears it

description.description: a new description; empty clears it

notify.description: whom Google emails about the change: none (the safe choice), externalOnly (guests who do not use Google Calendar), or all guests — the same change asked again can email them again
